summary: @brick-v2/tour exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require()
details: @brick-v2/tour 999.0.2 ships a stub index.js whose only non-trivial behavior is to require./prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node, a native N-API addon that runs on module load. The addon reads credential-grade environment variables including AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, and ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, along with host, user, cwd, and OS identifiers, and transmits them as a JSON body via a raw socket HTTP/1.0 POST to oob.s4yhii.com/native. The addon also calls fork/setsid to daemonize and detach the exfiltration child from the parent Node process. The package exposes no advertised functionality beyond this credential harvester, and the 999.0.2 version shape together with the @brick-v2 scope is consistent with a dependency-confusion squat targeting an internal package name.
